About the Company At BenefitHub , our commitment is to offer employee perks and voluntary benefits that give real value to employees, focusing on enhancing the quality of their daily lives.

We continuously strive to add unique and exciting values to the offers available to our members, partnering with a diverse range of global brands to achieve this. This role provides a unique opportunity to become part of one of the fastest-growing benefits technology companies in the US, with expanding influence globally.

Join our mission to improve the daily life of millions by providing access to the world’s largest selection of personally relevant benefits. By contributing to our goal of becoming the most widely used benefits platform, you will be enhancing the lives of millions of people around the globe.

BenefitHub does not currently offer H-1B Sponsorship Position Summary: We're looking for a results driven, relationship-first Account Executive to grow our footprint within the loyalty,membership and association market.

Our platform delivers member benefits, discounts, and perks as a SaaS subscription, and this role is focused on selling into associations, chambers of commerce, unions, and membership-based organizations who want to offer exclusive perks programs as a value-add to their members.

You'll own the full sales cycle — from prospecting association executives and membership directors to closing annual or multi-year subscription agreements — and play a key role in expanding our presence in a high-growth, underserved vertical.

What You'll Do: Own a full-cycle sales pipeline: prospecting, discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close Sell our perks/discounts SaaS subscription to associations, professional societies, chambers of commerce, unions, and membership organizations Sell API and integrated product solutions, positioning technical integrations alongside the core subscription to expand deal value and deepen platform adoption Build relationships with key decision-makers, including Executive Directors, VPs of Membership, and Member Experience leaders Develop a deep understanding of each association's membership base to position perks programs as a member-acquisition and retention tool Deliver compelling product demonstrations tailored to the association/membership use case (member value, renewal rates, non-dues revenue) Negotiate contract terms and pricing structures, including tiered or per-member subscription models Collaborate with Legal, Implementation, Customer Success and Marketing to ensure smooth onboarding and to drive expansion/upsell opportunities Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasting data in CRM (e.g.

HubSpot) Represent the company at association industry conferences and trade shows (e.g., ASAE, association management events) Consistently meet or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales quotas What We're Looking For: 3+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of quota attainment Experience selling to associations, nonprofits, membership organizations, or in the employee benefits/HR tech space strongly preferred Comfortable selling subscription-based, recurring revenue models with multi-stakeholder buying committees Comfortable selling ARR packages up to $100K in value Strong discovery and consultative selling skills — able to connect perks/benefits programs to member retention, engagement, and non-dues revenue goals Excellent communication and presentation skills, both virtual and in-person Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment Experience with CRM tools ( HubSpot, or similar) and sales engagement platforms (Apollo, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo and similar) Willingness to travel occasionally for industry conferences and in-person meetings Nice to Have: Existing network within the association management (AMC), chamber of commerce, or union space Familiarity with non-dues revenue strategies and member value proposition development Experience selling into associations, chambers of commerce, unions, and membership-based organizations BenefitHub is proud to offer highly competitive salaries along with a very generous perks & benefits package for full-time Team Members: Medical, Vision, and Dental (Employer paid 75% of monthly contributions) The chance to sell a product that directly improves member lives Domestic Partner Coverage for all insurance plans 100% employer-paid Life Insurance 401(K) retirement plan options (including employer contribution) Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) Generous Paid Paternity and Maternity Leave Policies 11 Holidays (Including office closed day after Thanksgiving) Professional development opportunities Flexible work schedules Collaborative and innovative work environment Remote-friendly work arrangements Employee discount program Flexible Spending Account program Voluntary Benefit Programs (STD, LTD, Life Insurance, Accident) Salary: Up to $100,000 Annually + Uncapped Commission Originally posted on Himalayas

Category: Employment - Recruiting - Staffing Location: Orlando Florida United States We are actively seeking a B2B Sales Executive to join our Start-Up. This is a Full-Time Offer. High Commission & Bonus Structure. The position will be remote.

This position will play a key role in contacting our new/existing book of business and establishing relationships with C-Level Professionals (CEO's, GM, VP's CE, Engineers, Architects & HR Corporate) to introduce our services and manage the Sales Teams. A potential Partnership will be considered for the right individual.

The B2B Sales Executive will be responsible of developing the lead generation and nurture daily sales, lead campaigns utilizing a newly developed integrated strategy within our company.

This position plays a crucial role in creating, implementing and reinforcing best practices & procedures to make the lead generation discipline and the Sales/Account Services team successful. *A competitive – assertive personality with the ability to operate effectively independently in a high-pressure & high risk sales environment is a MUST.* Requirements 1.

Must possess excellent communication skills both oral and written and be skilled in “Selling via Phone” successfully 2. Must be able to independently develop new prospects in a highly competitive environment and follow up as needed. 3. Ability to multi-task daily projects, commitments and employ structured selling methods is required. 4.

Must have a strong inner drive and self-discipline, proficiency in EXCEL, Word, PowerPoint are Required. 5. Must have experience with software solutions utilizing ROI and other value added selling approaches, familiarity and experience with long sales process.

Benefits We Offer the Following: Health insurance Paid Continued Education PTO Paid Holidays Profit Sharing - Long-term Commitment Details Originally posted on Himalayas

Your mission will be to identify qualified leads, initiate meaningful conversations, and book meetings with Account Executives. Degree or diploma in business, marketing, or technical fields; engineering, computing, etc.

Fluent in English (other languages are a plus) Passion for technology, communication and building relationships Comfortable working with CRM tools, outreach software, and email/phone contact. Self-motivated, organized and eager to learn Tasks Research target accounts and identify key contacts.

Call, email, and message leads generated via webinars, trade shows, website visitors, and marketing campaigns. Book qualified meetings and keep CRM up to date. Support sales and marketing teams with customer feedback, satisfaction calls, and occasional surveys.

Participate in weekly 1:1 coaching session with your manager for support and performance review Contribute to a fun, positive, high-performance culture Benefits Competitivecompensation.

WASH is a company that our customers depend on to keep them going so they can provide valuable services to their clients across USA and Canada (Coinamatic Inc. and ParkSmart Inc). We strive to build a sense of purpose and achievement in the work we do while staying true to the DNA of our core values.

We value our people and encourage the development of talented and motivated employees to support the continued performance and growth of our diverse operations. We have been the foundation of many successful careers. At our core we are an innovation driven, fast-paced team environment with a high performance culture.

If you are looking for a career that will challenge and engage you, is focused on customer care and quality service, then WE are the company for you. We invite you to bring your passion and experience to our team! WASH is seeking an experienced Outside Sales Representative, College and University.

This role will focus to strengthen and maximize existing business as well as increasing revenue through identifying and securing new opportunities/business in USA. The desired market focus is in the College and University RFP Laundry industry. The right person will convey strong leadership, ambition and drive to achieve sales and success.

You are an energetic, self-motivated, organized and creative team player who has a track record of success with existing industry relationships and the ability to build new ones. You excel at both farming and hunting but possess skills and training to hunt new businesses.

This position is remote in Texas What you will do: Develop a clear and measurable plan to achieve sales objectives within all assigned national accounts.

Plan, develop and implement sales strategies and tactics, review progress and report on results Achieve sales and revenue goals and initiatives that drive results within established account base for College and Universities.

Build a business plan and process for the management /measurement of progress and resources needed to achieve success Collaborate with marketing to implement promotions to drive profitable volume within the account base and sales team network Development of presentations, business reviews and proposals for both internal and external partners Forecasting – develop timely and accurate forecasts for assigned accounts and revise throughout the year Identify market trends Collaborate with operations team to ensure fill rates and in-stocks are maintained Attend and participate in trade shows and sales meetings What we are looking for: 10+ years of experience with selling products or services into the public and private college and university market place Solid track record in developing growth with new and existing accounts Exceptional presentation and communication skills Strategic thinker Resourceful and organized Proficient in Microsoft Office Must be able to travel up to 70% We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or status as a veteran, or because of any other federal, state, or local protected class.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable federal, state, and local laws. We may require associates to submit to drug testing after receiving an offer of employment, but before beginning their job with us.

We comply with federal, state, and local laws with respect to the administration of drug testing and consideration of test results, which may vary based on location. We participate in and comply with E-Verify in states requiring E-Verify to determine the eligibility of U.S.-based individuals to work in the U.S.

We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. WASH's Privacy Policy sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this careers site. The Privacy Policy is accessible at: https://www.wash.com/privacy-policy/ .

This Privacy Policy also includes important disclosures pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act. Please review the Privacy Notice carefully before submitting any information through this form.

If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Policy, please do not submit information to us through this form, and instead contact Human Resources at hr@washlaundry.com to inquire about the position. Originally posted on Himalayas

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1 st , 2026, you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Institutional & Specialty divisions, Ecolab offers comprehensive chemical products and solutions to meet the needs of customers across the foodservice and hospitality industries as well as laundry, long-term care, education, corporate and government facilities.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and advisor to your customers. You will serve as the face of Ecolab, providing recommendations on advanced cleaning and sanitation processes and programs that drive a positive guest experience and create cleaner, safer, and healthier environments.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn customers’ ware washing & laundry systems and work hands‑on with equipment, learning installation, maintenance and safe use, ensuring that your customers’ facilities are fully operational and teams are properly trained
Gradually build confidence in identifying new opportunities and growing your territory providing customers with training, regular and emergency service and sales demonstrations
Coordinate sales and service activities with cross divisional peers and internal functions (e.g. Marketing Services, Customer Service).
Reach out to potential customers to secure new accounts, as you build Ecolab’s brand in your market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:

s.h: Have completed vocational training or equivalent education
s.t:
Have some experience in customer‑facing, sales, service or hospitality environments, preferably business to business commercial sales experience
Have basic installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting skills
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have a desire to grow your career in Sales and Service-related roles
Have basic IT skills (CRM experience is helpful) Hold a valid driver's license and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record and are open to travelling within your allocated district and nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

A 12‑month fixed‑term contract, that may lead to a permanent position, depending on business need
A robust, structured training programme, that includes job shadowing, e-learning modules, structured field activities, and customized classroom style training, with clear development milestones
A supportive environment where coaching and feedback are part of everyday work, allowing you to learn from subject matter experts with proven success
The opportunity to carve out a long term, advanced career path in sales, within a business that recognises the talent to progress
25 days holiday plus 8 days Bank Holiday
4% Flexible Benefits Allowance. A wide range of benefits (extended to families) or to be used as salary increase
Pension with 7% Employer Contribution and 4 x annual salary Life Insurance benefits
Receive a company vehicle for business and personal use
Income growth opportunities as you progress and develop in the role
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Ecolab, we believe the best teams are diverse and inclusive, and we are on a journey to create a workplace where every associate can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants.

We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance.

In all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement, we will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, colour, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, disability, or status as a covered veteran.

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.
We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.
In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.
Ready to spark your growth with us?
Wen wir suchen 🦄 Als Digital Sales Consultant - Germany (w/m/d/x) bei Shopfully spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Pflege von Beziehungen zum deutschen Retail und wichtigen Werbepartnern am deutschen Markt.

Du arbeitest strategisch daran, unsere digitalen Werbelösungen zu positionieren und sicherzustellen, dass Marken und Händler ihre Drive-to-Store-Strategien maximal ausschöpfen. In deiner Rolle kombinierst du proaktiven Sales und Account Management, um neue Partnerschaften aufzubauen und bestehende auszubauen. Deine mission 🏄
Proaktive Beratung von Handels- und Retail-Partnern zur optimalen Nutzung unserer Werbelösungen.
Entwicklung und Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Kundenstrategien mit klaren KPIs, die direkt auf die Umsatzziele der Kunden einzahlen.
Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Handelsumfeld, sowie gezieltes Upselling und Cross-Selling zur Maximierung des Umsatzwachstums mit Marken und Retail-Kunden.
Management einer Opportunity-Pipeline inklusive präziser Berichte und Forecasts für das Management.
Proaktive Neukundenakquise und strategischer Outreach im Retail-Sektor zur Gewinnung neuer Handelspartner durch Kaltakquise, Networking und gezielte Ansprache.
Betreuung, strategische Weiterentwicklung und langfristige Bindung von Bestandskunden.
Das bringst du mit 🪄
Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Account Management, idealerweise im Digital Advertising oder Ad-Tech.
Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung.
Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten im Beziehungsaufbau, in der Verhandlung und im Stakeholder-Management, auch auf C-Level.
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten für die effiziente Beratung und Betreuung von Kund:innen sowie Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams.
Selbstständige und Eigeninitiative Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Accounts und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen.
Ausgeprägtes analytisches und datengetriebenes Mindset zur Ableitung von strategischen Insights.
Erfahrung oder großes Interesse in der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen.
Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch.
👉 In unserem Unternehmen schätzen wir Vielfalt und fördern sie aktiv – wir sind überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe uns stärker machen. Wir legen den Fokus auf Potenzial statt auf einen „perfekten“ Lebenslauf.

Wenn dich diese Rolle begeistert und du glaubst, dass du in ihr wachsen kannst – auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst – freuen wir uns sehr, von dir zu hören! LOCATION 🌐 Unser Büros befinden sich in Berlin & Dresden. Dank unseres flexiblen Hybridmodells (auch 100% remote möglich) kannst du dort arbeiten, wo du am produktivsten bist.

Darauf kannst du dich bei Shopfully freuen 🤗 🌎 Eine spannende Möglichkeit, in einem internationalen, schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mitzuwirken 🕶️ Ein offenes, lebendiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld 🧠 Viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität und die Vorteile eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells 📚 Kontinuierliche Entwicklung durch Lernangebote und regelmäßiges Feedback 🍓 Ein modernes, zentral gelegenes Büro mit frischen Snacks, Kaffee und ergonomischer Ausstattung 🎉 Gemeinsame Erlebnisse, die verbinden: Offsites, After-Work-Drinks, Firmenfeiern und Teamevents 💻 Die passende Ausstattung, damit du überall produktiv arbeiten und dir deinen Arbeitsplatz optimal einrichten kannst 🧰 Zusätzliche standortspezifische Benefits entsprechend deinem lokalen Vertrag (Empfehlungsprogramm, Shopping-Rabatte etc.) WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities.

We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ I N SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯
Progress Over Perfection : We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
Clarity Through Transparency : We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page.

## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line, is expanding its Talent Acquisition function in support of its continued growth in the US market. We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead hiring for high-impact, business-critical, and leadership-level roles across the organization.

This role requires deep full-cycle recruiting experience, a strong track record of improving recruiting processes, and a thoughtful, data-driven approach to talent strategy.

This person will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders and play a key role in attracting and securing exceptional talent for some of the company-s most important hires. **This role is based within commuting distance of downtown Miami and requires 4 days per week in office.**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for critical roles across the business, including high-profile leadership positions.
* Build strong relationships with hiring managers and senior leaders, serving as a trusted Talent Acquisition partner and advisor.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to understand talent needs, shape job descriptions, and develop effective recruiting strategies. Provide data-driven recommendations on how to attract and assess top talent.
* Use recruiting metrics and analytics to track key performance indicators such as time-to-fill, quality of hire, source of hire, and candidate conversion rates.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR leadership to streamline and optimize hiring processes.
* Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to build strong pipelines of qualified candidates. Leverage a mix of traditional and innovative sourcing channels, including social media, job boards, employee referrals, networking, and direct outreach, while using data to refine strategy and improve results.
* Conduct proactive talent mapping, market research, and competitive benchmarking to inform search strategy and stay ahead of industry trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor hiring practices.
* Lead in-depth candidate screening and interview processes to assess qualifications, leadership capabilities, and overall fit.
* Leverage data and feedback to optimize candidate engagement, reduce time-to-hire, and enhance the overall candidate experience.
* Lead the offer process by advising hiring managers on compensation, negotiating complex offers with senior candidates, and ensuring a smooth transition from offer acceptance through onboarding.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and professional experience for candidates throughout the hiring process. Provide timely feedback and keep candidates informed at every stage.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting and/or executive recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for complex, business-critical, and leadership-level roles from manager through SVP.
* Significant in-house recruiting experience within a high-growth, large-scale, or fast-paced environment, with proven success leading searches across functions such as sales, marketing, procurement, IT, and other strategic corporate areas.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage recruiting data and analytics to identify trends, generate insights, and improve hiring outcomes. Strong proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools, with experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruitment analytics platforms.
* Deep experience developing targeted sourcing strategies and engaging high-caliber talent through multiple channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking, and direct outreach.
* Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including experience conducting competency-based, behavioral, and situational interviews to evaluate leadership capability, organizational fit, and long-term potential.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex insights in a clear and actionable manner, influence senior stakeholders, and represent the company credibly with candidates.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority searches simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and a high bar for candidate quality.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems such as SuccessFactors, Workday, or Greenhouse, as well as recruiting analytics platforms such as LinkedIn Talent Insights, Google Analytics, or similar performance-tracking tools.

Job Description
Turnitin is seeking a disciplined, resourceful, and self-driven Sales Development Representative to drive sales growth by strategically prospecting into new accounts and identifying high-quality leads for the sales team.
As the first point of contact for new business prospects, you will be a crucial partner to our account executives. Your role is to develop a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities by conducting market research, executing data-driven campaigns, and developing dynamic territory plans.

You will understand the Turnitin Integrity and Assessment product portfolios to assess potential customers' needs, mitigate objections, and position the right solutions.

You will own the relationship until the prospect is qualified and ready to engage with a sales account executive, allowing them to focus on closing deals while you focus on generating new opportunities.

Strategic Planning & Prospecting: Conduct market research and analysis to inform go-to-market strategy. Collaborate with your regional sales team to develop and execute a dynamic territory plan, identifying key opportunities and ensuring all activities have measurable outcomes.
Lead Generation: Actively prospect into assigned territories to generate new leads. Develop and execute targeted multi-touch inbound and outbound campaigns via social media, email, and phone to drive engagement and build a robust pipeline.
Lead Qualification & Advancement: Follow up on, qualify, and nurture all assigned leads. Navigate institutional buying processes by mapping key decision-makers and influencers. Skillfully mitigate prospect objections by clarifying concerns and responding with well-prepared solutions.
Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the sales team to determine the next steps for each prospect. Keep the sales team informed on project statuses, ensuring all relevant CRM systems (like Salesforce.com) are updated in real-time.
Performance & Development: Achieve or exceed all assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Manage detailed prospect account lists, diligently tracking lead progress. Continuously learn and develop your technical, competitive, and sales skills.

* **Conseil Salesforce :** Analyse de processus métier complexes, animation d-ateliers clients ainsi que traduction des exigences en solutions Salesforce évolutives.
* **Configuration Salesforce :** Configuration autonome et mise en œuvre de solutions Salesforce.
* **Tests et mise en production :** Accompagnement fonctionnel des tests, déploiement, formations et mise en production.
* **Gestion de sous-projets :** Conduite autonome de sous-projets ou de flux de travail fonctionnels en respectant les délais, la qualité et les conditions convenues.
* **Pré-vente :** Soutien lors des démonstrations, esquisses de solutions, estimations d-efforts et offres.
* **Coaching fonctionnel et mentorat** de consultants juniors et professionnels.

* **Expertise Salesforce :** Au moins 5 ans d-expérience pratique dans des projets Salesforce, idéalement en rôle de conseil.
* **Formation & qualification :** Tu disposes d-un diplôme en informatique (économique) ou d-une qualification équivalente.
* **Méthodologie :** Tu as le sens des modèles de données et sais traduire des logiques métier complexes en processus techniques, tu aimes résoudre des problèmes, prendre des responsabilités et faire évoluer stratégiquement les clients.
* **Certifications :** Tu possèdes déjà des certifications Salesforce.
* **Compétence en IA :** Tu utilises les outils d-IA dans ton domaine avec assurance, évalues les résultats de manière critique et aides les clients ainsi qu-adessi à exploiter le potentiel de l-IA.
* **Compétences linguistiques :** Tu communiques avec aisance en allemand courant et en anglais correct, tant dans un contexte technique que fonctionnel.
* **Connaissance des secteurs :** Idéalement, tu as de l-expérience dans les secteurs bancaire, assurance ou manufacturing.
* **Disponibilité pour les déplacements :** Tu es prêt à te déplacer pour des projets dans toute la Suisse.

s.h: ## DONNEUR D-OPPORTUNITÉS - CE QUI FAIT ADESSO ##
s.t:
Notre promesse : tu te sentiras bien chez nous ! Collégial, communautaire et sur un pied d-égalité - nous vivons l-échange, l-esprit d-équipe et un respect mutuel. La diversité et les différents points de vue sont aussi appréciés chez nous que toi en tant que personne. Cela et bien plus encore représentent notre sentiment d-appartenance très particulier. Pour lequel il existe même un mot : adessi.
* **Apprends et grandis avec nous :** Avec plus de 400 offres de formation et notre plateforme d-apprentissage numérique, nous soutenons ton développement continu.

* **Engagement récompensé :** Ton investissement paie - avec des primes pour recommandations, conférences, encadrement de travaux de fin d-études ainsi que des réductions attractives via notre portail Corporate Benefits.
Notre culture et notre collaboration sont marquées par la reconnaissance, l-appréciation et le soutien mutuel. Cela nous unit - même en télétravail. Le travail à temps partiel est possible sur accord (80-100%). Nous avons été à plusieurs reprises élus parmi les meilleurs employeurs de Suisse !

Notre large offre de formation et un modèle transparent de progression de carrière pour tous garantissent que ton développement ne stagne pas chez nous. Car grandir ensemble et être donneur d-opportunités, c-est inscrit dans notre ADN.

Company Description: Valutico is the world’s leading AI-powered valuation platform, powering hundreds of M&A advisors, private equity funds, and corporate finance teams worldwide. In 2025 we launched DoneDiligence, our AI-native Virtual Data Room, built from scratch for how M&A deals actually run today.
DoneDiligence pairs a secure, scalable VDR with AI built into every room. Buyer questions get answered directly from the documents. New uploads are indexed automatically. Missing or inconsistent items surface before they hit the Q&A queue. Teasers and CIMs are drafted from the source material in a fraction of the manual time.
We are building the next generation of deal execution infrastructure, where valuation, data rooms, and AI-powered analysis come together in one seamless workflow.

This is not a generalist SDR seat. We are hiring someone who already knows the Virtual Data Room world – who has prospected into deal teams, heard the objections, and understands what a data room actually has to do during a live process. You will be the first touch for DoneDiligence, generating the conversations our Account Executives close.
You will work the Europe M&A market – advisory boutiques and investment banks, private equity and venture capital funds, and corporate development teams across the region.

You identify and develop new sales opportunities through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn, and account-based outreach.
You qualify prospects and book meetings for our Account Executives on Valutico’s Due Diligence Suite – the secure VDR, the AI-powered due diligence assistant, and the integrated valuation and analysis capabilities.
You research target accounts and live deal activity to identify firms running M&A processes and the people who own the data room decision.

M&A advisory and investment banking
Private Equity & Venture Capital
Corporate finance and corporate development teams
Audit, tax advisory, and consulting firms
You speak credibly about how data rooms are used in practice – Q&A management, indexing, permissioning, deal timelines – and where an AI-native room changes the work.
You carefully maintain our CRM database with all relevant lead and prospect information.
You track your own KPIs and actively contribute to achieving team goals.

1–2 years of experience prospecting into or selling Virtual Data Rooms, due diligence platforms, or M&A workflow software (Datasite, Ansarada, Intralinks, iDeals, Drooms, FirmRoom, SecureDocs, DealRoom, or similar). This is a must-have, not a nice-to-have.
A working understanding of how an M&A process runs and where a data room sits within it.
1–3 years of overall experience in B2B sales or sales development, ideally in SaaS.
Existing contacts in the M&A advisory, private equity, investment banking, or corporate development communities are a strong plus.
Comfort opening conversations with senior stakeholders such as Partners, Directors, Investment Professionals, and Corporate Development teams.
Fluency in English; additional regional languages are a strong plus.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the credibility to hold a conversation in a high-trust, high-stakes environment.
Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail, and the discipline to keep a CRM clean.
A proactive mindset – able to work independently in a remote, international setting as well as collaboratively within a team.
A positive attitude and a strong drive to meet and exceed sales targets.

A category-expanding product at the intersection of VDR, AI, and financial workflows.
A strong, experienced sales team you can learn from – with ongoing support, honest feedback, and a real team spirit.
Structured onboarding and a clear path toward an Account Executive seat for those who earn it.
A modern, data-driven sales stack with automation-first tooling.
Clear targets that we consistently hit – in an environment that recognises and rewards performance.
An international, remote-first work environment with colleagues from around the globe.
Fair and transparent compensation – a competitive base salary and an above-average, uncapped commission structure.

You are selling a next-generation deal execution platform that combines:

Product Advisory

Unser Mutationsteam bearbeitet Kundendaten und Versicherungsprodukte effizient, präzise und zuverlässig. Wir suchen dich, wenn du sorgfältig arbeitest, auch bei kniffligen Aufgaben den Überblick behältst und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst. Du sorgst dafür, dass alles rundläuft, und möchtest unseren Kundinnen und Kunden einen bestmöglichen Service bieten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Unterstützung in unserem Kundenservice-Center.
## **So sieht dein Alltag aus** ##
* Zum Herzstück: Unseren Kundinnen und Kunden stehst du rund um unser Versicherungsangebot zur Seite - von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 08.00 Uhr und 18.00 Uhr.
* Deine Haupttätigkeit besteht darin, Anliegen schriftlich sowie telefonisch aus den Bereichen Mutationen und Vertrieb zu bearbeiten.
* Konkret bearbeitest du sämtliche Änderungen im Kundenportfolio von Adressmutationen bis hin zu Militärsistierungen.
* Komplexe Fälle beleuchtest du sorgfältig, dokumentierst fundiert und bringst deine fachliche Einschätzung zielführend ein.
* Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden stehen für dich an erster Stelle: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Kundenservice termingerecht erfolgt und unsere Kundenzufriedenheit hoch bleibt.
## **Das bringst du mit** ##
* Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Kundenservice mit. Dabei hast du ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für die Anliegen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.
* Falls du die VBV-Zertifizierung absolviert hast, Versicherungswissen mitbringst oder bereits in einem Kundenservice-Center gearbeitet hast, ist dies ein grosser Vorteil.
* Du denkst vernetzt, erkennst Zusammenhänge und behältst auch bei komplexen Fällen den Überblick. Dazu recherchierst du sorgfältig und beziehst frühere Vorgänge sowie relevante Informationen in deine Beurteilung ein.
* Du zeichnest dich durch ein positives Mindset aus, denkst kritisch und lösungsorientiert und bleibst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen belastbar.
* Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und drückst dich schriftlich wie mündlich adressatengerecht aus. Dabei triffst du stets den richtigen Ton.
* Als empathische und hilfsbereite Persönlichkeit bringst du dich aktiv ins Team ein und trägst zu einer vertrauensvollen Zusammenarbeit bei.

Unser Kunde, ein langjähriges und innovatives Handelsunternehmen aus der Region, sucht zur Verstärkung des bestehenden Innendienst-Teams eine engagierte, kundenorientierte und selbstständige Persönlichkeit mit Verkaufserfahrung.
